guard: a human bearer is released only after its lifecycle-pinned public-KV watchers exist; repeated exchanges retain a push-bound consumer, while every unbound consumer is replaced for a complete cold replay even when post-crash traffic is pending
command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && PATH=/workspace/state/tools/nats-server-v2.12.12-b:$PATH corepack pnpm smoke:user-spawn:live
why: Interactive CLI bearers use the agent profile's lifecycle-pinned public-KV watch rails even
though their presentation card is an endpoint. The auth service must therefore use its
ephemeral trusted provisioner before releasing the bearer, while preserving an already-safe
push-bound consumer so overlapping commands and bearer refreshes do not reset a live observer.
Pending counts do not prove ownership: ordinary traffic can arrive after an ungraceful exit,
so every unbound consumer is replaced while simultaneous lifecycle ensures stay coalesced.

mutations.name: release an interactive bearer without provisioning its public-KV watchers
mutations.find:
if (typeof grant.lifecycleUid === "string" && grant.lifecycleUid)
          await ensureWatches({ owner, actor, lifecycleUid: grant.lifecycleUid });
mutations.expectRed: ✗ FAIL: human exchange pre-provisions both lifecycle-pinned CLI public-KV watchers
mutations.cell: human exchange pre-provisions both lifecycle-pinned CLI public-KV watchers

mutations.name: reset a canonical live watcher on every bearer exchange
mutations.expectRed: ✗ FAIL: a second human exchange retains both live watcher consumers instead of resetting them
mutations.cell: a second human exchange retains both live watcher consumers instead of resetting them
mutations.afterRestore: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build

mutations.name: treat post-crash pending traffic as proof of a live watcher
mutations.expectRed: ✗ FAIL: a human exchange replaces both abandoned watcher snapshots before cold rebind
mutations.cell: a human exchange replaces both abandoned watcher snapshots before cold rebind
mutations.afterRestore: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build
